final: WITH t AS (SELECT o.weathprofile AS wp, tel.bandusagepct AS bu, tel.telescregistry AS id FROM telescopes tel JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = tel.observstation WHERE tel.detecttempk > 152.1), g AS (SELECT wp, AVG(bu) AS avg_bu, COUNT(id) AS n FROM t GROUP BY wp), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bu) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT g.wp, g.avg_bu, g.n, g.avg_bu - m.mean_avg AS dev_from_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g.wp
